title: Fix completion_events.dart docstring — natural key description omits curriculumId that the enforced index actually includes
why: The docstring's stated natural key (4 columns) doesn't match the @TableIndex it sits directly above (5 columns, adds curriculumId). A maintainer trusting the prose when writing a new dedup check or merger elsewhere would build the wrong key.
recommendation: Update the docstring to list all 5 columns (or drop curriculumId from the index if it was never intended — needs a one-line confirmation from whoever added it in DNI-323).
acceptance_criteria: Docstring and @TableIndex column list textually match.
